# Hook points and fields: rac2

Every hook point a mod can take ([hooks](../hooks.md)), and the game state exposed to
scripts by name. Signatures use `void i32 u32 i64 u64 f32 i16 u16 i8 u8`; `u32` is also a
game address.

## Hook points

| Id | Name | Signature | Parameters | Discs |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rac2.player.take_damage` | `Hero_TakeDamage` | `void(i32)` | amount | ntsc, pal, ntsc2 | Takes a hit's points from the hero's health (the hero at 0x189E20 on NTSC-U, health at +0x24CC), after the armour's scale; the hero's state machine calls it for each hit. |
| `rac2.combat.get_hit` | `Moby_GetHitMessage` | `u32(u32,u32,i32)` | moby, mask, keep | ntsc, pal, ntsc2 | The pending hit for a moby from the hit ring (the damage, f32 at +0x2C; its source at +0x38), or 0: what an enemy's damage path reads. |
| `rac2.weapon.take_ammo` | `Weapon_TakeAmmo` | `i32(i32,i32)` | item, amount | ntsc, pal, ntsc2 | Takes rounds of a weapon's ammo (item -1: the one in hand); a weapon with no capacity has endless ammo. Rac1's TakeAmmo. |
| `rac2.moby.record_death` | `Moby_RecordDeath` | `void(u32,i32,i32)` | moby, flags, arg | ntsc, pal, ntsc2 | A moby's death recorded: its experience, the bestiary and its bolt drop (the moby's s16 at +0xB4); crates call it too. |
| `rac2.level.load` | `Level_Load` | `i32(i32,i32)` | load, resume | ntsc, pal, ntsc2 | Loads a level (new, or resumed after a death); it calls the gameplay file's loader. |
| `rac2.player.approach_speed` | `Hero_ApproachSpeed` | `void(f32,f32)` | up, down | ntsc, pal, ntsc2 | Eases the hero's speed (+0x1B4) toward his target speed (+0x1B0) each tick, at up when speeding up and down when slowing; rac1's approach_speed. |
| `rac2.player.nanotech_steps` | `Hero_NanotechSteps` | `i32(u32,u32,u32)` | a0, a1, count | ntsc, pal, ntsc2 | Adds the nanotech levels' steps of health to *count; the recount of the most health each tick adds the boosts after it (the HUD's experience bar calls it too, ignoring count). |
